scope: VCFv4.5 FORMAT M/DPM/ADM base-modification fields, their 30 named aliases, Number=M cardinality and example tables VCF5.2/VCF5.7.

VCFv4_1.scan: No M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], M5mC or base-modification field family found in pinned VCFv4.1 source scan.

VCFv4_2.scan: No M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], M5mC or base-modification field family found in pinned VCFv4.2 source scan.

VCFv4_3.scan: No M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], M5mC or base-modification field family found in pinned VCFv4.3 source scan.

VCFv4_4.scan: No M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], M5mC or base-modification field family found in pinned VCFv4.4 source scan.

M.meaning: Fraction of DNA or RNA bases modified with the given ChEBI ID; values must be between 0 and 1.

DPM.meaning: Total read depth for reads able to detect the base modification with the given ChEBI ID.

ADM.meaning: Read depth for reads with the base modification with the given ChEBI ID.

rules: Number=M has one value for each possible base modification for the corresponding ChEBI ID; cardinality depends on genotype and possible modifications for corresponding alleles.
The ID suffix must be A, C, G, T, U or N; U is synonymous with T.
If any base-modification key is present for a sample, GT must be defined.
The number of values for an allele equals the number of bases on either strand in its allele sequence that can contain the modification.
Values follow the order in which eligible bases occur in the allele sequence.
For N modifications, positive and negative strand values are both represented, with the negative-strand value immediately after the positive-strand value.
Values follow GT allele order and phasing; unphased allele values are aggregated at the first occurrence of the unphased allele value.
MISSING allele values and symbolic alleles contain no relevant bases and contribute no modification values.
Unstranded values are stored at the base with lowest POS and other values are MISSING; unstranded N modifications use the positive-strand value and missing negative-strand value.
All FORMAT keys matching M[0-9]+[ACGTUN], DPM[0-9]+[ACGTUN] and ADM[0-9]+[ACGTUN] are reserved, even where the ChEBI ID does not correspond to a valid base modification.
The named aliases are recommended instead of corresponding ChEBI keys.
ADFM[0-9]+[ACGTUN] and ADRM[0-9]+[ACGTUN] are not reserved; Type=M fields are intrinsically stranded.
Base-modification information on a reference-block record applies to all applicable bases covered by the block.

examples.interpretation: Informative examples only; constraints are sourced from Number=M and M/DPM/ADM definitions, not example records.

source_internal_blocker.history: Both spellings were introduced in the same upstream VCFv4.5 RC2 commit 44aedcff5032a6a16f271085e2d9b16de1f0ccbf; no later correction was found in retrieved file history.
source_internal_blocker.control: Do not silently normalize case or accept both spellings without authoritative clarification.
